envelope.description: Writers carry meta.repo and the missing-file class

body.title: Writers carry meta.repo and the missing-file class
body.summary: resolveRelations (src/indexer/resolver.ts) keeps a relative import that resolves to no file unresolved with class 'no-candidate', reason 'target-file-missing', and puts meta.repo on every resolved relation; indexManifest writes DEPENDS_ON with meta.repo = meta.file = repoPath; the cross-file Pass 1 rewire writes meta.repo and the importing file's absolute meta.file. Anchors: resolveRelations (src/indexer/resolver.ts:63) keeps an import unresolved when resolveImportPath finds no file (:105-107); indexManifest is the private method at src/indexer/index.ts:1080 and writes DEPENDS_ON with no meta at :1111-1113; Pass 1's rewire writes IMPORTS with no meta at src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:242-244. Depends on t4 for the counted, merged pending writes.
acceptanceChecks: A relative import of './missing.js' is 'no-candidate' with reason 'target-file-missing'; one of an existing file resolves to its file id as today
A refused DEPENDS_ON or rewire is counted against the repository, not the unattributed counter
A DEPENDS_ON kept awaiting is removed only by deleteUnresolvedForRepo

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/resolver-file-target.test.ts: missing relative import is no-candidate/target-file-missing; resolved relations carry meta.repo; DEPENDS_ON and Pass 1 rewire carry meta.repo and absolute meta.file
